accepted_stage4_conclusion: No detectable benefit of real trajectories B over A in official direct-answer format; B and D have symmetric flips. Rule routing gains about9pp over A on test trackable questions, demonstrating usable track information not used by that model/template.
primary_scope: Test trackable251 QA; main-four231 also reported. R/D101 is entirely trackable. Test all602 and full749 supplemental; full includes development used for prior tuning.

methods.mcnemar: Exact two-sided conditional binomial test on discordant correctness; p=1 with zero discordances.
methods.bootstrap: Question-level paired percentile95%CI,1000 resamples,numpy default_rng(42),sorted qa_id within each subset,as Stage4.
methods.positive: Positive delta, exact two-sided McNemar p<.05 and bootstrap lower bound>0.
methods.weak_inequality: For >= hypotheses, report observed ordering separately from inference. Significant positive differences support a transition; significant negative differences contradict it. With no prespecified noninferiority margin, nonsignificance or an observed tie alone does not establish population noninferiority.
methods.multiplicity: Unadjusted exact p and CIs reported; additionally Holm-adjust four H7 adjacent comparisons across two templates. No familywise claim for exploratory dimensions.

hypotheses.criterion: positive criterion on B-A; strict final-line parser

hypotheses.scope: R/D101 test questions, each template separately
hypotheses.criterion: Report observed monotonicity (both deltas>=0), each exact p and CI. Statistical support requires positive evidence for both transitions; otherwise distinguish observed ordering from uncertainty. Significant negative transition contradicts monotonicity.

hypotheses.scope: R/D101 test questions, each template separately
hypotheses.statement: B-events is not lower than the frozen rule.
hypotheses.criterion: Report observed gap to rule. Positive criterion supports at least reaching rule; significant negative delta contradicts it; an overlapping CI remains inconclusive for noninferiority, with no post-hoc margin.

reasoning_parser.rule: Require the final nonempty line to match case-sensitive Answer: <value>. No fallback to earlier lines or reasoning. sp/mcq require exact legal uppercase letter; numerical exact2/3/4/5 or more; ordering exact complete permutation of its labels separated by commas. Parse failure wrong.

numerical_guidance.user_confirmed: Preserve reasoning and constrain only final answer; total1024 tokens.
numerical_guidance.reasoning_semantics: Free reasoning prefix; EOS allowed only after a final newline Answer: with legal number. Token-limit truncations remain failures, not retried or dropped.

examples: First5 sorted test R/D qa_id answered correctly by reasoning B and first5 wrong, including parse failures. Preserve whole output and evidence; manually describe whether it cites tracks, without inferring private reasoning or editing evidence.
